name: eqcheck
description: EqCheck is a writing productivity tool that analyzes how communication will land and provides a practical plan for adjusting its tone before you send.

interface.longDescription:
EqCheck is a writing productivity tool and tone checker for written communication. It reads how an email, sales message, support reply, or other written response will land, then helps you adjust it before you send.

The check tool gives a calibrated read across six tone dimensions: directness, warmth, clarity, pressure, respect for boundaries, and ambiguity. It also scans for generic machine-written patterns. Each dimension is descriptive, not a pass or fail. High pressure is not always wrong, and low warmth can be right for the message.

The rewrite tool returns a phrase-by-phrase plan for hitting a target tone. EqCheck provides the analysis and practical guidance; you retain control of the final wording.
capabilities: Check the tone of a draft
Rewrite a draft toward a target tone
defaultPrompt: Check the tone of this email before I send it.
Rewrite this to sound warmer without losing the point.
How will this cold email land with a busy founder?

positive.description: User asks EqCheck to read the tone of an email draft before sending. The check tool should score the six dimensions and flag any AI tells.
positive.prompt: Check the tone of this email before I send it: 'Per my last message, I need the deck by end of day. Do not miss this again.'
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a calibrated read across the six tone dimensions (directness, warmth, clarity, pressure, respect for boundaries, ambiguity) plus a scan for machine-writing tells, without rewriting the text.

positive.description: User worries a reply reads as too harsh and wants a tone read rather than a rewrite.
positive.prompt: Does this reply come across as too harsh? 'That is not what I asked for. Redo it.'
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a tone read describing directness, warmth, and pressure for the supplied text, framed as descriptive rather than pass/fail.

positive.description: User asks to soften a blunt message. The rewrite tool should return a plan toward a warmer tone.
positive.prompt: Rewrite this to sound warmer without losing the point: 'Your invoice is overdue. Pay it today.'
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a phrase-by-phrase rewrite plan toward a warmer target tone; the calling model, not EqCheck, produces the final wording.

positive.description: User wants a more direct sales follow-up with the AI-sounding phrasing removed.
positive.prompt: Make this sales follow-up more direct and cut any AI-sounding phrasing: 'I just wanted to circle back and seamlessly reconnect on our previous conversation.'
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a rewrite plan that increases directness and flags or removes generic AI-sounding phrasing.

positive.description: User asks how a cold outreach note will read for a specific kind of recipient. The check tool should return the tone read for that audience.
positive.prompt: How will this cold email land with a busy founder? 'Hi, I would love 15 minutes to show you what we built.'
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a tone read for the supplied draft, noting pressure and directness relevant to a busy-recipient audience.

negative.description: Unrelated weather question. No message tone is involved, so no EqCheck tool should trigger.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Travel booking request. This is a transaction with no draft to read, so no EqCheck tool should trigger.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Tokyo next Friday.

negative.description: Document summarization request. Summarization is out of scope for a tone checker, so no EqCheck tool should trigger.
negative.prompt: Summarize this PDF in three bullet points.

review.commerce_description: EqCheck is a subscription service for the check and rewrite tools. New accounts may get a free trial; ongoing access is a paid monthly or annual subscription processed by Stripe through eqcheck.app. The MCP tools themselves do not sell goods or process payments; sign-up and billing happen on the eqcheck.app website.
